about.message: Detects nzbs with fake media files.
about.description: Short description of the Fake Detector extension shown in settings.

description.message:
If a fake is detected the download is marked as bad. NZBGet removes
the download from queue and (if option "DeleteCleanupDisk" is active) the
downloaded files are deleted from disk. If duplicate handling is active
(option "DupeCheck") then another duplicate is chosen for download if available.

The status "FAILURE/BAD" is passed to other scripts and informs them about failure.
description.description: Full description of the extension shown in settings. DO NOT translate 'NZBGet'.

requirements.message: This script requires Python 3.8.x to be installed on your system

bannedextensions_desc.message:
BannedExtensions.

Downloads which contain files with any of the following extensions will be marked as fake.
Extensions must be separated by a comma (eg: .wmv, .divx). Matching is case-insensitive.

The file names listed in the nzb are checked as soon as it is added to the queue,
so a banned file posted as-is is rejected before anything is downloaded.
Files inside archives are checked as the archive volumes are downloaded.
